670993d401385c8ff0b50887fc419248b19a1471.summary: Blog post by Lukas Stefanko, with a video demo, on Android Clipper, a trojan that replaces cryptocurrency addresses copied to the clipboard with the attacker's wallet address. The post says it was first found on Google Play, and gives Dr. Web's August 2018 discovery outside Google Play and ESET's February 2019 discovery in Google Play as its history.

dates.q: August 7, 2018 – Discovered first Android Clipper outside of Google Play by Dr. Web

dates.q: February 8, 2019 – Discovered first Android Clipper in Google Play by ESET
